jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT AUTHORIUM

Authorium is a high-growth GovTech SaaS company transforming how government agencies manage administrative operations. Our platform replaces fragmented document management solutions and decades-old legacy systems with a unified user interaction and data layer that manages billions of dollars in public funds; serving state, local, and federal agencies that in turn support millions of citizens and businesses. Authorium sits at the intersection of modernization, public service, and technology innovation like AI-enabled workflows. Our team moves fast, collaborates across teams, and builds for impact.

 

ABOUT THE CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER ROLE

We are hiring a Customer Success Manager who is outcomes-driven, organized, and energized by helping customers get measurable value from a product.

You will develop a deep understanding of each customer’s workflows, usage patterns, and operational needs, paired with an equally deep understanding of how Authorium works under the hood: translating customer technical usage and needs into structured input for Product, and translating product roadmap and capabilities into language non-technical customer leadership can act on.

You will carry a portfolio of customer accounts and be accountable for adoption metrics, understanding user experience, customer health indicators, potential expansion signals, and ultimately be measured by retention outcomes. You will be the connective tissue between our customers, our product organization, and our revenue team.

 

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Adoption Depth: Drive customers from implementation into active, measurable, durable product usage. Build adoption plans grounded in each customer’s actual workflows, not generic playbooks. Track usage signals and intervene with substance when adoption stalls.

User Experience & Customer Workflow Mastery: Become a true expert in how each customer uses Authorium day to day — the people, the processes, the friction points, the workarounds. Surface the user-experience reality that account-level metrics alone won’t show.

Product Liaison: Serve as the structured voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Translate raw customer feedback into prioritized, contextualized product input that helps shape roadmap decisions and improves user experience to solidify adoption and growth.

Customer Translation: Translate the product roadmap, new capabilities, and platform direction into language non-technical customer leadership can use. Help customer stakeholders understand what’s coming, what it means for their work, and how to plan for it.

Customer Accounts Team Member: Operate as a peer alongside commercial Account Managers, sharing context, surfacing signals, and coordinating on customer strategy. You bring the adoption and product lens; together with the AM team, you cover the customer end to end.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with Solutions and Implementation during onboarding handoffs. Coordinate with Support and Training on customer issues that touch enablement or adoption. Work with Marketing on case studies and references where adoption stories warrant it.

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days: Onboarded onto core product usage patterns, product and customer metrics, and learning the customer portfolio and business cases. Actively shadowing current team calls and contributing to debriefs. Developing a clear picture of each account’s workflows, stakeholders, and adoption status.

First 90 Days: Preparing and leading customer engagement motions in collaboration with other team members. Forming initial customer adoption plans and documentation for every account. Reviewing and evaluating key customer health indicators on a regular (weekly) basis. Contributing to cross-functional customer health internal scrums, and proactively supporting proactive engagement motions.

First 6 Months: Established a picture of overall customer portfolio adoption, health, and retention path (risk, opportunities). Coordinating closely with Sales, Support, Delivery, Product to influence plans around broader customer adoption patterns. Ongoing contributions to process development.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 1–3 years in a customer-facing role with substantive product depth — CSM, solutions consulting, technical account management, implementation, or product-adjacent client services. GovTech or B2B SaaS preferred but not required

  • Scrappy and confident — you operate with high autonomy, you don’t wait to be told how to engage a customer, and you bring a point of view to the conversation

  • A natural translator: equally comfortable explaining a customer’s technical usage and needs to a product team, and explaining a product roadmap to a non-technical customer leadership team

  • Data forward — you can read a usage dashboard, build analyses, and use evidence to back up a recommendation

  • Comfortable presenting — to customer executives, to internal product leadership, to mixed audiences. You can hold the room without overselling.

  • A team player by default — you operate well alongside Account Managers, Solutions, Support, and Product, and you understand that no single function owns the customer alone

  • Curious about how software products work and motivated to develop real product depth, without needing to be the one configuring it

  • Self-aware about scope: you can go deep on the right things and resist the pull to disappear into every weed of every customer issue

  • Startup-ready: comfortable with ambiguity, excited by building from scratch, and energized (not overwhelmed) by wearing multiple hats

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience / knowledge of government, procurement, grants, or compliance-adjacent industries

  • Familiarity with tools like Jira, Pendo, Claude, Miro, Notion, Teamwork

  • Based in the Washington DC metro area with interest in regular in-person customer collaboration

WHAT WE OFFER

  • $70,000 - $95,000 competitive base salary with variable compensation tied to customer outcomes (including retention and product usage)

  • Equity participation in a growing GovTech company

  • In office (Washington DC)

  • 100% employer-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with Profit Sharing Plan

  • Flexible PTO

  • $500 home office stipend

  • Commuter stipend

jobs.title: Associate Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Authorium

Authorium is a high-growth GovTech SaaS company transforming how government agencies manage administrative operations. Our platform replaces fragmented document management solutions and decades-old legacy systems with a unified user interaction and data layer that manages billions of dollars in public funds; serving state, local, and federal agencies that in turn support millions of citizens and businesses. Authorium sits at the intersection of modernization, public service, and technology innovation like AI-enabled workflows. Our team moves fast, collaborates across teams, and builds for impact.

About Position

As an Associate Solutions Engineer (ASE), you are a delivery owner. You will be responsible for key customer delivery and engagement motions - participating in discovery, articulating design and configuring client ready solutions, and maintaining clear documentation of system decisions. You are responsible for the accuracy of your tasks, the clarity of your communication, and meeting project milestones.

This role is a blend of system collaborative consulting, and both individual and team-based contributions. As a member of the Solutions team, you will collaborate with all other business units to continuously improve our product, our engagement motions, and the quality of our delivery. You will embody our C.A.R.E. values (Collaborate, Accountable, Resilient, Establish Excellence) as you grow into a subject matter expert.

What You’ll Do

Own Delivery Execution

  • Support the configuration of templates, workflows, and rules based on established design patterns.

  • Assist in translating customer requirements into functional system setups.

  • Maintain a clear pulse on your assigned tasks, surfacing blockers or questions to your lead early.

Documentation & Logic Mapping

  • Draft design documentation, workflow logic diagrams, and configuration notes.

  • Ensure all "as-built" documentation is accurate and reflects the final state of the customer environment.

  • Help prepare handoff materials for Quality Assurance to meet the demanding needs of our customers.

Customer Support & Shadowing

  • Co-lead discovery sessions and working meetings to capture requirements and action items.

  • Increasingly take on facilitation for specific, defined segments of the implementation journey.

  • Prepare presentation materials and platform demos for customer-facing meetings.

Quality Assurance & Troubleshooting

  • Execute disciplined QA practices and UAT scripts to validate that configurations meet requirements.

  • Perform initial troubleshooting for configuration issues, documenting reproduction steps for more complex bugs.

  • Assist in data validation and clean-up to ensure seamless platform launches.

Internal Growth & Partnership

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to understand new features and platform capabilities, based on your customers needs.

  • Leverage internal playbooks and templates to ensure consistency across customer engagements.

  • Actively participate in peer reviews to learn and refine best practices with a goal of improving technical accuracy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a technical or analytical role (Implementation, Support, or Junior Analyst) preferably within B2B SaaS.

  • Strong logical aptitude: Ability to understand conditional logic (if/then/else) and structured data.

  • High attention to detail: Proven ability to manage documentation and follow complex processes without skipping steps.

  • Effective Communication: Ability to explain technical steps clearly to both internal teammates and external users.

  • Adaptability: Comfort in fast-paced technical environments with continuous product delivery and ongoing learning.

  • Must be based in (or planning to relocate to) Washington, DC — this role is hybrid.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting public-sector (or similar high-compliance environments) customers and familiarity with procurement, contracting, grants, budgeting, or vendor workflows.

  • Exposure to integration-adjacent delivery work (e.g., data flows, sequencing considerations, APIs, or ETL concepts).

  • Demonstrated ability to assist in delivery across multiple stakeholders and surface risks proactively.

  • Experience contributing to or improving delivery standards, templates, or playbooks.

Benefits

  • Salary Range: $75,000-$98,000

  • Stock options (details at offer stage)

  • 100% benefits coverage for employee

  • 401K Profit Share plan

  • Flexible PTO

  • Home office stipend

  • Comprehensive wellness benefits

  • Commuter stipend for hybrid roles

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Authorium

Authorium is a high-growth GovTech SaaS company transforming how government agencies manage administrative operations. Our platform replaces fragmented document management solutions and decades-old legacy systems with a unified user interaction and data layer that manages billions of dollars in public funds; serving state, local, and federal agencies that in turn support millions of citizens and businesses. Authorium sits at the intersection of modernization, public service, and technology innovation like AI-enabled workflows. Our team moves fast, collaborates across teams, and builds for impact.

About Position

We're looking for a driven, intellectually curious Sales Associate to join Authorium's growing go-to-market team. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of government procurement and enterprise SaaS sales. Ideal for someone eager to build a career in GovTech.

 

The Mission is to own and drive outbound strategy across SLED agencies, as well as prime contractors and integrators.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own a pipeline of inbound and self-sourced GovCon prospects from first touch to Implementation.

  • Run consultative product demos tailored to each prospect's contracting profile

  • Manage accounts through the conversion funnel and drive activation

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads using structured discovery frameworks, surfacing budget, authority, need, and timeline signals.

  • Research target accounts using tools like GovWin IQ, CaleProcure, and CA eMarket solutions to identify active solicitations, contract vehicles, and key procurement stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate and timely CRM hygiene, logging activities, contacts, and opportunity progression.

  • Work with channel partners (resellers, system integrators) to co-develop state and local opportunities, particularly around contract vehicles such as DGS SLP, CMAS, and NASPO Cloud.

  • Contribute to sales playbooks, messaging experiments, and persona-based outreach sequences — you'll have a real voice in how we go to market.

  • Attend industry events, conferences, and government procurement convenings in the Sacramento area to build pipeline and brand awareness.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in SaaS sales, familiar with government affairs, procurement, or a closely related field.

  • Have achieved Close-won ARR in GovTech and B2G Environment (able to share details of past performance).

  • Genuine curiosity about how government procurement works and a belief that better software can improve public outcomes.

  • Clear, confident communicator; both written and verbal with the ability to tailor your message to a CPO, Contracting Officer, a CIO, or a deputy director.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this is a high-growth environment where you'll help define how we operate.

  • Familiarity with state and local procurement concepts is a strong plus —State Contracting Manual (SCM), SLP, NASPO, StateRAMP, contract vehicles, and similar terminology.

  • Negotiate pricing and terms within established guardrails; coordinate with Sales leadership on enterprise deals.

  • Located in the Sacramento, CA area.

If the job posting is listed as hybrid or an employee is located within 30 miles of one of our hub cities (San Francisco and Washington, DC), hybrid work is required.

Benefits

  • OTE: $200,000-$220,000

  • Stock options (details at offer stage)

  • 100% benefits coverage for employee

  • 401K Profit Share plan

  • Flexible PTO

  • Home office stipend

  • Comprehensive wellness benefits

  • Commuter stipend for hybrid roles

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT AUTHORIUM

Authorium is a high-growth GovTech SaaS company transforming how government agencies manage administrative operations. Our platform replaces fragmented document management solutions and decades-old legacy systems with a unified user interaction and data layer that manages billions of dollars in public funds; serving state, local, and federal agencies that in turn support millions of citizens and businesses. Authorium sits at the intersection of modernization, public service, and technology innovation like AI-enabled workflows. Our team moves fast, collaborates across teams, and builds for impact.

ABOUT THE HEAD OF ENGINEERING ROLE

We are hiring a Head of Engineering to build and grow the team that builds the platform that state and local governments use to manage their complex workflows such as procurement, contract management, and grant management.

This senior engineering seat reports directly to the executive leadership. The Head of Engineering is a builder and a leader: owning the team, the technical execution, and executing with excellence on behalf of our customers. Authorium’s engineering team is small, but mighty and growing. We are looking for a leader that can get directly engaged in the work of the engineering team, directly execute key initiatives, and provide guidance and direction for the team.

You will work collaboratively across both on-shore and off-shore engineering squads to deliver a platform experience that is highly secure, meets some of the most stringent compliance requirements, and provides an excellent user experience to our customers and their stakeholders. Our customers are government agencies with real procurement deadlines, real compliance obligations, and limited tolerance for downtime. This is mission-critical software delivery and important work is tied to its reliability, performance, and experience.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Hands-On Technical Contribution: You are comfortable in the codebase. You are able to take work yourself rather vs. only routing it. You personally investigate complex, ambiguous problems before deciding how to tackle them with the team. You are a technical mentor to the engineering teams you work with.

Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and grow a small blended team of full-time engineers, contractors, and an offshore agency partner across multiple time zones. Run 1:1s and career coaching, set clear expectations, manage capacity, and build a culture of collaboration and ownership and excitement around delivery.

Delivery Accountability: Own what engineering commits to and whether it lands. Set priorities, unblock the team, set realistic dates, surface slippage before it becomes a customer conversation, and course-correct in the open. Delivery predictability is the metric that matters most in your first year.

Technical Execution & Architecture: Own architecture and technical-debt decisions inside the platform and interface with security and compliance leaders. Create documented plans that acknowledge tradeoffs and guide executive decisionmaking. Be a critical member of the leadership team driving Authorium’s platform vision forward.

Engineering Quality: Set the standard. Own code review norms, testing expectations, deployment safety, and the delivery and reliability metrics the team is measured against.

Production Reliability & Security: Own uptime, incident response, and on-call structure. Partner with InfoSec and Compliance on the security and compliance posture our customers audit us against, including public-sector requirements as we expand.

AI-Native Engineering Practice: Champion tools like Claude and Cursor across the team to remove toil and create leverage. Define where agents are trusted, where their output is reviewed, what quality bar applies to agent-produced code, and how we measure output.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Work directly with Product, Delivery/Implementation, Customer Experience, and Solutions. Translate business priorities into scoped, sequenced engineering plans, and engineering constraints into language non-technical colleagues and government customers can act on. Expect to be in front of customers when it matters.

Hiring: Interview, assess, and help set the technical bar for engineering hires. Plan, forecast, and manage team capacity.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days: Learn the codebase and the customer business case — ship something real with support from the team. Get to know the architecture, the fragile parts, the open incidents, and every person on the team. You have a clear-eyed read on where delivery actually stands.

First 90 Days: Delivery commitments are yours and they are being met and/or negotiated. The team's operating cadence — planning, review, on-call, incident response — is understood and running. Documented execution plans against capacity and priorities are the norm.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 7+ years building software, with at least 2–3 years leading engineers directly — and you are still writing and reviewing code today

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems and cloud architecture

  • Demonstrable recent technical depth: you can walk us through an architecture you designed, a production incident you personally diagnosed, and a technical decision you got wrong and corrected

  • Track record of maintaining predictable quality and delivery, with specifics on how you managed it and what it cost

  • Experience leading a distributed team, holding quality and communication together across time zones

  • Fluency with modern AI-assisted development, plus a real point of view on where agent-generated code needs human scrutiny and where it does not

  • Comfortable in a growing startup environment where capacity and capabilities are being defined, refined, and operationalized.

  • Strong internal and external communication skills; written, calls, in-person engagements.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience at an early-to-mid-stage startup

  • Experience in GovTech, public-sector SaaS, or another regulated, audited environment (FedRAMP, StateRAMP, SOC 2, HIPAA)

  • Experience building or scaling an offshore engineering function

  • Based in San Francisco Bay Area or Washington DC

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Salary Range: $200,000–$250,000

  • Stock options (details at offer stage)

  • 100% benefits coverage for employee

  • 401K Profit Share plan

  • Flexible PTO

  • Home office stipend

  • Comprehensive wellness benefits

  • Commuter stipend for hybrid roles

  • Direct executive engagement, real proximity and support for company decision making

  • Genuine ownership of the platform's technical execution and the shape and direction of the team that builds it

  • Experience working for a mission-forward organization, operating as a public benefit corporation with a mission to support the critical work of government

Our customers are government agencies with real procurement deadlines, real compliance obligations, and limited tolerance for downtime. This is mission-critical software delivery and important work is tied to its reliability, performance, and experience.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Hands-On Technical Contribution: You are comfortable in the codebase. You are able to take work yourself rather vs. only routing it. You personally investigate complex, ambiguous problems before deciding how to tackle them with the team. You are a technical mentor to the engineering teams you work with.



Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and grow a small blended team of full-time engineers, contractors, and an offshore agency partner across multiple time zones. Run 1:1s and career coaching, set clear expectations, manage capacity, and build a culture of collaboration and ownership and excitement around delivery.



Delivery Accountability: Own what engineering commits to and whether it lands. Set priorities, unblock the team, set realistic dates, surface slippage before it becomes a customer conversation, and course-correct in the open. Delivery predictability is the metric that matters most in your first year.



Technical Execution & Architecture: Own architecture and technical-debt decisions inside the platform and interface with security and compliance leaders. Create documented plans that acknowledge tradeoffs and guide executive decisionmaking. Be a critical member of the leadership team driving Authorium’s platform vision forward.



Engineering Quality: Set the standard. Own code review norms, testing expectations, deployment safety, and the delivery and reliability metrics the team is measured against.



Production Reliability & Security: Own uptime, incident response, and on-call structure. Partner with InfoSec and Compliance on the security and compliance posture our customers audit us against, including public-sector requirements as we expand.



AI-Native Engineering Practice: Champion tools like Claude and Cursor across the team to remove toil and create leverage. Define where agents are trusted, where their output is reviewed, what quality bar applies to agent-produced code, and how we measure output.



Cross-Functional Partnership: Work directly with Product, Delivery/Implementation, Customer Experience, and Solutions. Translate business priorities into scoped, sequenced engineering plans, and engineering constraints into language non-technical colleagues and government customers can act on. Expect to be in front of customers when it matters.



Hiring: Interview, assess, and help set the technical bar for engineering hires. Plan, forecast, and manage team capacity.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days: Learn the codebase and the customer business case — ship something real with support from the team. Get to know the architecture, the fragile parts, the open incidents, and every person on the team. You have a clear-eyed read on where delivery actually stands.



First 90 Days: Delivery commitments are yours and they are being met and/or negotiated. The team's operating cadence — planning, review, on-call, incident response — is understood and running. Documented execution plans against capacity and priorities are the norm.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years building software, with at least 2–3 years leading engineers directly — and you are still writing and reviewing code today

 - Strong fundamentals in distributed systems and cloud architecture

 - Demonstrable recent technical depth: you can walk us through an architecture you designed, a production incident you personally diagnosed, and a technical decision you got wrong and corrected

 - Track record of maintaining predictable quality and delivery, with specifics on how you managed it and what it cost

 - Experience leading a distributed team, holding quality and communication together across time zones

 - Fluency with modern AI-assisted development, plus a real point of view on where agent-generated code needs human scrutiny and where it does not

 - Comfortable in a growing startup environment where capacity and capabilities are being defined, refined, and operationalized.

 - Strong internal and external communication skills; written, calls, in-person engagements.




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience at an early-to-mid-stage startup

 - Experience in GovTech, public-sector SaaS, or another regulated, audited environment (FedRAMP, StateRAMP, SOC 2, HIPAA)

 - Experience building or scaling an offshore engineering function

 - Based in San Francisco Bay Area or Washington DC




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Salary Range: $200,000–$250,000

 - Stock options (details at offer stage)

 - 100% benefits coverage for employee

 - 401K Profit Share plan

 - Flexible PTO

 - Home office stipend

 - Comprehensive wellness benefits

 - Commuter stipend for hybrid roles

 - Direct executive engagement, real proximity and support for company decision making

 - Genuine ownership of the platform's technical execution and the shape and direction of the team that builds it

 - Experience working for a mission-forward organization, operating as a public benefit corporation with a mission to support the critical work of government

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Authorium

Authorium is a high-growth GovTech SaaS company transforming how government agencies manage administrative operations. Our platform replaces fragmented document management solutions and decades-old legacy systems with a unified user interaction and data layer that manages billions of dollars in public funds; serving state, local, and federal agencies that in turn support millions of citizens and businesses. Authorium sits at the intersection of modernization, public service, and technology innovation like AI-enabled workflows. Our team moves fast, collaborates across teams, and builds for impact.

About the Position

This is a foundational role for an engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment and wants to accelerate their career by being "in the room" where our most complex architectural decisions are made.

You'll help tackle our most complex technical challenges, from modularizing our core domain to designing the next generation of our workflow engine. As a key contributor to the technical integrity of our platform, you'll ship mission-critical features and work closely with a high-caliber team to power our next major phase of expansion

What You Will Be Doing

  • Shipping Core Features: Deliver complex, high-impact features across our platform—from building robust versioning systems to designing intricate approval workflows and permission models.

  • Technical Evolution: Participate in architectural decisions that scale across multiple customer configurations. You’ll contribute to ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) and help drive the modularization of our core domain.

  • Engineering Craft: Uphold a high bar for technical excellence. You’ll engage in deep, architectural code reviews and contribute to the advancement of our automated quality gates.

  • AI-Native Workflow: Leverage Cursor and Claude to offload boilerplate and focus on complex implementation. You’ll help refine our AI-first patterns—including agentic testing and automated reviews—ensuring the team operates at maximum leverage.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 3+ years of professional full-stack experience. We value deep engineering fundamentals—system design, database optimization, and clean architecture—over fluency in any specific syntax.

  • Systems Thinker: A demonstrated ability to understand and contribute to complex domain objects and data models in production environments.

  • High-Agency: You don’t wait for a perfectly groomed ticket. You are comfortable partnering with product managers to turn ambiguous requirements into elegant technical specs.

  • Security Minded: You treat security as a core engineering discipline. You have a strong working knowledge of defensive coding practices and the authorization models required to protect sensitive data.

  • Quality Obsessed: A history of writing clean, maintainable code with comprehensive testing. You take pride in your PR history and believe that "done" includes documentation and observability.

Nice to Have

  • Modern Frontend Experience: Familiarity with React and/or Next.js — we're actively evolving our frontend stack, and if React or Next.js is in your background, we want to hear about it.

  • Ruby on Rails Proficiency: Strong knowledge of Rails conventions and an interest in (or experience with) modular monoliths.

  • Complex Document Infrastructure: Experience with document generation (PDFs), rich text editors, or building systems to process unstructured data within secure workflows.

  • Regulated Industry Experience: Previous work in compliance-heavy environments such as GovTech, FinTech, or HealthTech (FedRAMP, SOC 2, or HIPAA).

  • Infrastructure Curiosity: Experience with or a strong desire to learn AWS infrastructure (ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) and modern deployment pipelines.

  • Startup Veteran: Previous experience in a fast-growing startup ($5M–$30M ARR range) where you navigated rapid change and contributed to a scaling product.

Benefits

  • Salary: $120,000 - $150,000

  • Offers equity

  • 100% benefits coverage for employee

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible PTO

  • Home office stipend

  • Comprehensive wellness benefits

  • Commuter stipend for hybrid roles
